name: DFW 2021 IECC (CZ3) new construction
description: Houses permitted under the 2021 IECC as adopted locally by DFW cities: R-49 ceilings, R-20 or 13+5ci walls, U-0.30 / SHGC 0.25 windows, 3 ACH50, R-8 attic ducts, radiant barrier decking common. Duct leakage is not seeded because the plan table gives no value for this edition. Inspect and override.

era.code_basis: 2021 IECC adopted locally by most DFW cities (DOE; NAHB 2021 IECC CZ3 table).

sources.citation: RhoeFlow plan v2, Era-based defaults for DFW table (claude/01-plan/research-and-plan.md); estimates to seed the questionnaire
2021 IECC Table R402.1.2 climate zone 3 values as reproduced in NAHB suggested amendments to the 2021 IECC
DOE Building Energy Codes Program, Texas adoption status
RhoeFlow plan v2 §Era-based defaults: radiant barrier common in 2010+ DFW builds

ceiling_insulation_cavity_r.basis: 2021 IECC CZ3 prescriptive ceiling R-49. Replace with the measured depth.

wall_insulation_cavity_r.basis: Prescriptive R-20 cavity, or R-13 cavity plus R-5 continuous. R-20 is assumed; if the wall is 2x4, set cavity to 13 and continuous to 5.

window_ufactor.basis: 2021 IECC CZ3 fenestration U-0.30. An NFRC sticker replaces this.

air_leakage.basis: 2021 IECC CZ3 tested maximum 3 ACH50. The actual test report replaces this.

roof_radiant_barrier.basis: Radiant barrier roof decking is common in 2010+ DFW builds. Confirm from the attic photo.
